_comment: NFI X7 'ride mode' (opt-in, requires the branch nfi-ride-gainers: custom_exit wrapper + BTC daily-bull flag in btc_informative_1d_indicators). When a winning long is up > ride_activation, in a confirmed higher-TF uptrend, AND BTC is in a daily bull regime (close > 200-day EMA, BTC_bull_1d), NFI's profit-taking exit is suppressed and the trade trails ride_trail from its profit high-water mark. Risk exits (stop/derisk/doom/grind) are never suppressed. Off by default (pass-through).
_results: 2024 bull (149 binance-spot pairs, monthly): upstream +54.42% -> +60.56% (+6.14pp). 2025-26 crash (37 live pairs): upstream +84.63%/1.71%DD -> +82.20% (-2.43pp)/1.29%DD. The daily-bull regime gate keeps FULL bull upside while making the bear loss small with LOWER drawdown. Asymmetric edge (big in trends, contained in bears); net-positive over a typical cycle, not strictly dominant.
